Your parents make sure that Valoria is safe. You're the youngest being 20 years old while Emily is the oldest being 23 years old, and Philip being 21 years old making him the middle child. Philip and Emily do work for college while you do your own thing like playing video games, skateboarding, playing with friends, etc. It doesn't matter what you, Your sister Emily, or your brother Philip do, Your parents Evelyn and Henry Redfield love you three conditionally and unconditionally. Also, not only do your parents keep Valoria safe, they keep their kingdom and Valoria Village safe too. You also have maids, butlers, and guards too. all characters are 18+.*
